Plini Roessler-Holgate (born 1992 or 1993), known mononymously as Plini, is an Australian guitarist and songwriter. He began his career by releasing music under the name Halcyon, before switching to the use of his first name.
Stavroz was formed in 2011 by Ijsbrand & Gert, both dj’s and sound engineers looking for a way to channel their musical antics. Soon thereafter, Maxim & Pieter joined on live shows and in the studio.

Zymosis is a psychedelic music project which has brought a bright light to the psy culture over the past 10 years. Zymosis is composed of two people from Kyiv, Ukraine who share their minds and souls to make you fly into the depth of trance.

The Bombay Dub Orchestra brings together a world of musical influences which fuses electronic, ambient, western classical, Indian classical, semi-classical, and other sounds from around the globe. It all began some seven years ago when producer Garry Hughes and string arranger/composer Andrew T.

Anchorsong is a music producer and solo live act. Started his career in Tokyo in 2004 and based in London now. He has become globally recognized for his unique live performance, creating electronic music live with a sampler (MPC2500) and a keyboard right in front of the audience.

There are several artists using the moniker "Jungle." 1. Jungle is an English modern soul musical collective formed in 2013 by childhood friends Josh Lloyd-Watson (J) and Tom McFarland (T). They initially emphasized artwork and videos over their personal identities before expanding into a seven-piece live band.
songs.wiki: "Back on 74" is a song by the British band Jungle, released as the fourth and final single from their album Volcano on 28 July 2023 through Caiola and AWAL. It was written by Jungle members Josh Lloyd and Thomas McFarland and their newest member Lydia Kitto, and produced by Lloyd. It reached the top 40 in the UK and New Zealand.

In the midst of their musical journey, Bondax's story unfolds with 2024 marking a significant chapter in their career. The duo, comprised of George Townsend and Adam Kaye, emerged onto the scene as teenagers, defying the notion of an overnight success.

Alexander Kotz, known professionally as Elderbrook, is a English musician, songwriter and producer. His career as a musician began in 2015, when he released his first EP, which contained the song, "How Many Times" which went on to be remixed by German duo Andhim, becoming one of Mixmag's best songs of 2015.

songs.bio: Oliver Koletzki first started producing music in the eighties with a Commodore 64. At aged 13, he started taking guitar and piano lessons. His inspirations were Breakdance and Hip Hop music of the early nineties. Since passing his A-levels, he has been studying music at the Berlin Humboldt University.
Four Tet is the name used by Kieran Hebden (born 1977 in Putney, London, UK) for his experimental electronic music-oriented solo efforts, to differentiate from his work with post-rock band Fridge.

songs.bio: The son of two professional musicians, for 10 years Sébastien attended the academy of music learning technique and musical theory on piano and drums. Soon he began visiting record stores, where he was introduced to a new world of sounds and styles.

It was the mid-‘90s, the heyday of techno in Munich- Riem, home to the Optimal and other legendary clubs, when Daniel Bortz stepped into the never-ending, untiring loop of the stoically pumping bass drum. He was born in Berlin in 1981, but shortly thereafter his family moved to Bavaria,where he grew up.

Originally from Greystones, a seaside village near Dublin, and now based in Berlin, Mano Le Tough makes disco influenced house music which is characterized by an emphasis on melody and emotion. Mano released his "warhorn e.p." on Prins Thomas' Internasjonal imprint in 2009 and has also released tracks on District of Corruption.

THDS is a collaboration of a Belgian-Portuguese composer and a Belgian-Columbian singer. Growing up in the same Jesuit forest school, they have developed an antagonist but creative brotherhood out of which emerges a smooth acoustic-electronic / latin-western / green-organic music
Dokho is a Melodic House project/alias presented by Franz Hlusek aka Fast Distance. As Dokho he has managed to play this summer at the beautiful Greenfields by Tomorrowland.

French music producer, guitarist and live act Massane creates melodic house and techno music rich with sonic textures inspired by a wide range of genres. Attracting attention from those in the scene early on, Massane released his debut EP Visage 1 (No Return) on Lane 8's This Never Happened in early 2020.

Younger Brother was formed by Simon Posford (Hallucinogen, Shpongle) and Benji Vaughan (Prometheus, The Zap!) in 2002. The name "Younger Brother" is inspired by an indigenous Colombian tribe called The Kogi, for whom the band wrote their first song.

Etyen is a Beirut-based musician, composer and music producer described as being “at the forefront of the Lebanese electronic music scene”. He is an Alumni of the Red Bull Music Academy and OneBeat 2015.

Twenty-five year old David August's first musical introduction was being forced into Piano lessons at the tender age of five years old. As time passed and David's ivory skills grew, he came to love the instrument and excelled in its classic format.

Guthrie Govan (born 27 December 1971 in Chelmsford, Essex, England) is an English guitarist and winner of Guitarist Magazine’s “Guitarist of the Year” award in 1993. Govan read English at the University of Oxford, though he left after a year to pursue a career in music.
Olivier Mateu’s wide-ranging inspirations and interests find their ultimate outlet as Rodriguez Jr., positioning him as Mobilee’s new master of eclecticism.
During the '90s, Marcus Füreder DJ'd in nightclubs, which led to production and label operation. Under the name Plasma, he released the 2001 album Shadow Kingdom on his Bushido label.

songs.bio: A collaboration between members of Dub Trees, The Orb, Suns of Arqa, Tangerine Dream, Dreadzone and Uri Geller. Inspired by the Kumba Mela gathering which is held every four years by the River Ganges.

George Fitzgerald first appeared on our radar with his "Don't You" cut on Scuba's Sub:stance mix. Fast-forward a year and he's got his first release on Hotflush, dropping the future garage soul of "The Let Down" and a luscious dubtech gem in "Weakness".

Shpongle is a psychedelic electronic music project from England that formed in 1996. The group includes Simon Posford (a.k.a. Hallucinogen) and Raja Ram (one of three in The Infinity Project). The duo are considered to be one of the progenitors of the psybient genre - a genre combining world music with psychedelic trance and ambient.

El Buho aka Robin Perkins is an English musician living in Amsterdam. He is bridging the gap between Latin American rhythms, digital bleeps, owl bass and found sounds, inspired by Birds, Cumbia, the Andes, Bass, clicks & claps.

David Starfire is a producer, composer, multi-instrumentalist and DJ based in Los Angeles and San Francisco. His production style is eclectic, fusing world music with dance, hip hop and everything in-between. He’s developed quite a following and his unique sound is catching the ears of music fans across the globe.
Music that touches the listener has a certain necessity in its core – a kind of lure that very well encapsulates Jesper Ryom’s musical universe.
Tel Aviv-based duo of Dori Sadovnik and Niv Arzi. Informed by post-punk, new wave, and a plethora of club sounds old and new, they have cleaved a singular path with their hefty discography.

Born and raised in Umeå, Sweden, the music of electronic duo Gidge (consisting of Jonatan Nilsson and Ludvig Stolterman) echoes the vast, snow-covered woodlands of their home. Their music has been described as melancholic, emotional and organic. The duo is currently on Applescal's label Atomnation.

The Verve were an English rock band formed in Wigan in 1990 by lead vocalist Richard Ashcroft, guitarist Nick McCabe, bass guitarist Simon Jones, and drummer Peter Salisbury. Guitarist and keyboardist Simon Tong joined the band during its first reunion.
songs.wiki: "Lucky Man" is a song by the band The Verve and is featured on their third album, Urban Hymns. It was released 24 November 1997 as the third single from the album, charting at #7 in the UK Singles Chart. The song was also the band's second, and so far last Top 20 hit in the USA.

songs.bio: Saul Hudson (born 23 July 1965, Stoke-on-Trent, England), better known by his stage name Slash, is a British-American musician. He is the lead guitarist of the American hard rock band Guns N' Roses, with whom he performed and recorded between 1985 and 1996, and rejoined in 2016.

songs.t: The Final Thing on My Mind
songs.bio: The Pineapple Thief is an English progressive rock band founded in 1999 by Bruce Soord in Yeovil, Somerset. As of June 2024, the group consists of Soord on vocals, guitars, and keyboards, Jon Sykes on bass, Steve Kitch on keyboards, and Gavin Harrison on drums.
Yogi Lang is the singer of the German progband RPWL. He released his first solo-album "No Decoder" in 2010 http://www.yogilang.com
RICEWINE is a solo music project by Talae Rodden, a musician from Melbourne, VIC, Australia. Rodden passed away on August 10, 2026, when a tree struck the car he was a passenger in.

Dhruv Visvanath is a Singer-Songwriter and accomplished acoustic guitarist from New Delhi, India. Having spent a large part of his childhood in various parts of the world like London, Zambia, Hong Kong, and Mumbai to name a few, Dhruv uses the collective experiences from his past to craft his songs and stories.
Harnessing the rational to illuminate the transcendental, Steve Young aka Hedflux is synthesising a gleaming new event-horizon of controlled, pulsating energy across dancefloors worldwide.
The Sensational Vibrations that emanate from YAIMA materialize from an unconventional Spectrum of History.

Elliot Moss is a multi-instrumentalist songwriter, producer, and visual artist from New York. He released his debut album Highspeeds in 2014, which was played, recorded, and mixed primarily by himself.

Gary Clark Jr. (born February 15, 1984) is an American guitarist and actor based in Austin, Texas. Described as being the future of Texas blues, Clark's resume has included sharing the stage with various legends of rock and roll. He has stated that he is "influenced by blues, jazz, soul [and] country, as well as hip hop".

Berlin-based Booka Shade (Walter Merziger and Arno Kammermeier) leapt to the forefront of contemporary dance music in 2005 with their classic singles “Body Language” (with M.A.N.D.Y.) and “Mandarine Girl”, and their debut full-length Memento.

Safri Duo is a Danish percussion duo composed of Uffe Savery (born April 5, 1966) and Morten Friis (born August 21, 1968). Initially classically oriented, by 1999 they were discovered by a label executive working on classical music.

songs.bio: An alias of German producer & electronic composer Roger Shah, formerly known as DJ Shah. Roger Shah has released a number of tracks as Sunlounger, such as "White Sand" in 2006 and "Aguas Blancas" in 2007. The first Sunlounger album, "Another Day On The Terrace" was released in 2007, and comprises two CDs, "Chill" and "Dance".

Birthed in late 2019 after a long flourishing friendship between American artist Pierce Fulton and Canadian producer Gordon Huntley, Leaving Laurel have developed a penchant for introspective melodic electronic music.
Utrecht based duo Micha Heyboer and Jordi van Achthoven have been crafting their computerized soul together since 2013.

Sound Quelle is a project of Russian musician (Valery Lebedev) from the city of Togliatti. In his works, Sound Quelle focuses on a beautiful harmonious music in combination with moderately aggressive lines bass.

Matteo Mancuso, born on 22 November 1996, is an Italian jazz and rock guitarist hailing from Palermo, Sicily. He began his guitar journey at the age of 10, playing alongside his father Vincenzo. By the age of 12, he had already taken to the stage to perform live.

Tab Benoit (born November 17, 1967 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, United States) is a blues guitarist, musician and singer. He plays a style that is a combination of Swamp blues, Soul blues and Chicago blues. He plays Fender guitars and writes his own music compositions.

Grandbrothers are Erol Sarp and Lukas Vogel. After meeting at university in Dusseldorf, Erol and Lukas formed Grandbrothers to tie together their respective musical backgrounds and disciplines: Erol is a trained jazz pianist, while by day Lukas constructs synthesizers at Access Music.

songs.bio: Edinburgh born, London Based producer Barry Can't Swim (real name Joshua Mannie) is quickly becoming well known for his trademark blend of skillfully crafted electronic production mixed with Jazz inspired strings and keys.

Berlin-based composer, producer and sound designer Ben Lukas Boysen joined Erased Tapes in 2016 with the re-release of his debut album Gravity and new album Spells. Spells merges programmed piano pieces with live instruments, combining the controllable technical world and the often unpredictable aspects of live improvisation.

songs.bio: A Hip-hop / Abstract / Electronic artist from Tours, France. Born in Poitiers. Name "Mounika" comes from the "Out Of Breath" film, American version of Godard's movie.

Electronic / house music duo and brothers from Halle, Germany. Monkey Safari are real Nightlife addicts and indeed lovers of club culture. As owners of the legendary Charles Bronson club and purveyors of labels like What!What! Records (since 2008) & Mambo (since 2011), they truly are ambassadors of house and techno in their hometown.

songs.bio: Chester Burton Atkins born 20 June 1924 - Died 30 June 2001 in Nashville, Tennessee, United States (1942–1996) . was an American guitarist and record producer.

Viken Arman, along with a generation of like-minded artists, is pushing the boundaries of electronic music not only towards the future, but also towards the past. Fusing ancient melodies with electronic beats to create magical vibes that go beyond dance music brings rich cultures together in mystical musical journeys.

Ceas is a one-man sonic venture coming out of Sydney with Scandinavian roots emerging as progressive and electronic sounds. What started as an all acoustic, shoegazing-inspired singer/songwriter project in Sweden was brought across the ocean to sonically grow.

Polar Inc. is the project of music producer Adam Spence. Melodics meet movement when Cape Town based Polar Inc. creates a piece of music. Through every melody, scenes are built and dissected to prepare the audience for the pinnacle of each track, an amalgamation of rhythm and emotion.

Under the Berlin-based label Lenient Tales as well as Cologne-based minimal techno record label Traum Schallplatten, Parra for Cuva consists of German artist Nicolas Demuth. Born in Cologne in 1991, Demuth studied audio design at the University of Popular Arts in Berlin.

In a lot of ways, Aukai’s self-titled debut is the sound of Markus Sieber bringing his career full circle. Having spent part of the ’90s playing rock music in East Germany, the composer/multi-instrumentalist then shifted his focus to acting, only to have music creep back into his life after a mind-altering move to Mexico.

songs.bio: Monolink is the stage name of Steffen Linck, a German Liveact, singer-songwriter and electronic dance music producer who specializes in ambient, techno, electronica and house genres.

There's more than 1 band called Silk. For the Japanese band that was not formed by 大森絹子(Kinuko Oomori), please refer to ＳｉＬＫ. Silk is a five-man R&B group best known for their 1993 #1 single "Freak Me" from their debut album Lose Control.

Afterclapp is a producer / Dj from Florianópolis, Brazil. Heavily influênced by hiphop and bass music his work is a gathering of heavy beats, bass and samples from vinyl and old radio recordings. Inner City LP, his debut album, features jazzy and soulful samples with fresh beats. A blend of oldschool and new technics in music production.

Ercos Blanka always deliver the finest productions, a very refined and unique style, very melancholic, with rich melodies and always storytelling progressions. In his new EP, "The Guardian" we can feel this again, and we upgrade the experience with an extraordinary remake by another favorite, Alexander Bogdanov.

Gone is the name of more than one artist: 1) instrumental rock band 2) Swedish rock band 3) Chilean underground artist and producer 4) American Sludge band 5) American dreamcore/slowgaze band 6)South Korean Rapper and Producer 1) Formed by Greg Ginn of Black Flag, Gone mixed atonal jazz, heavy rock, and funk, releasing several albums…
Hailed as “LA's best kept secret”, David “DAVI” Khanjian internationally acclaimed DJ, producer, radio host, and label owner grew up surrounded by the sounds of Pink Floyd and Led Zeppelin.

Esteble consists of two close friends (Joep Esseling & Bram Harmsen) from Rotterdam, The Netherlands. Together they make music inspired by their surrounding and a variety of sounds. Their music is rather warm yet vibrant and diverse in styles. Whether you're at home or in the club the music will fit the moment.

Andrew Bird (born July 11, 1973) is an American musician. He was born in Lake Bluff, Illinois but currently resides in the Los Angeles area. Bird is a singer, a violinist and, since 2004, a guitarist. He is also an accomplished whistler.
Eli & Fur is a DJ duo from London, comprising of Eliza Noble and Jennifer Skillman. Living in London and friends since the age of 16, they have both been passionate about music from a young age.

Vintage Culture is an artist who lives and breathes the culture of dance music. At the threshold of one billion combined streams on Spotify and Youtube, Vintage a.k.a Lukas Ruiz has been featured on the Cover of Rolling Stone Magazine and chosen by Forbes Magazine's list of 30 under 30, becoming one of the most influential Brazilian…
The Avener is a French Deep House and Electro music producer. He is most famous for "Fade Out Lines", a Deep House rework of "The Fade Out Line", a song by Phoebe Killdeer & The Short Straws.

Vandelux is the alter-ego of Evan White, a truly independent closet musician from Vancouver Canada that entered the digital production scene in 2016 with some bootleg remixes that landed him on the top of the underground music charts.

Australian graphic designer and visual artist Jack Vanzet produces music under the name Thrupence. He first attracted attention in 2011 with his series of 'Conceptual Mixtapes' released independently on Bandcamp. The following year brought Vanzet's 'Voyages' EP.
There are 2 artists under the name Jakarta. 1- Jackarta is a band formed in 1981 in Belgrade.

Nicolás Jaar is a Chilean-American composer and recording artist based in New York. Nicolas Jaar was born the 10th of January 1990 in New York but spent most of his childhood in Santiago de Chile, only to return to his place of birth as a teenager.

Oliver Siebert, better known by his stage name Oliver Dollar (sometimes stylised as Oliver $) is a German record producer. He was born in Berlin. His collaboration with Jimi Jules, "Pushing On", peaked at number 15 on the UK Singles Chart.

Pavlov is an indie rock/post-punk trio from Litija, Slovenia, formed in 2017. The band released their debut album Predor on November 25th, 2021. In addition, there appear to be several other artists named Pavlov.

There are two artists/bands by the name of Frameworks. 1. Frameworks are a melodic hardcore band from Gainesville, FL. Forming in early 2011, they released their debut EP Every Day Is The Same, in October 2011. They incorporate elements of post-hardcore and screamo/skramz together, promoting their own brand of melody driven hardcore.

DMX Krew is the recording name of Ed Upton. He has released 6 full albums on Aphex Twin's label Rephlex Records, one full album on Legowelt's Strange Life Records, and numerous singles/EP's for both Rephlex, his own Breakin Records, and various other.

Earth Trax is Bartosz Kruczynski, a ambient house & techno producer from Warsaw, Poland. He is arguably among the leading names in Poland's current electronic music scene. His music is deeply emotive and explores a wide-ranging sonic palette that is complemented by well-defined artistic concepts.

Maribou State is Chris Davids and Liam Ivory from Hertfordshire. Liam asked Chris to play bass for his band. When they moved up north to go to university, the band fell by the wayside and the pair began making electronic music in their home studio, forging a partnership that would soon become Maribou State.

With a keen grasp on textural and emotive songwriting, Fennell combines bare piano, minimalist synth and string-scapes, and etherial vocals to create the sounds of SYML.
Niladri Kumar is the son and disciple of Sitar Maestro Pandit Kartick Kumar, who is the senior most disciple of Pandit Ravi Shankar.

A contemporary instrumental fusion/funk band, Mughal-e-Funk is a combination of ambient music, groovy melodies and incredibly inventive percussion and bass parts. Comprising four members, the line-up includes Kami Paul on the drums, Rufus Shahzad on synths and keyboard, Rakae Jamil on Sitar and Farhan Ali on the bass.

Nice DJ-Producer from Catalonia. He uses lots of different samples from other songs and mixes them making nice tracks as Knuff, one of his most famous tracks. Could be tagged as a club-house-hiphop producer, his tracks are nice for clubs and ambient-music club.

Flexible Fire is the alter-ego of celebrated Argentine producer Airdraw. During the last years he has worked on a sound where he explores sounds a little more Organic, including traditional instruments such as woodwinds, guitars and violins, added to hybrid percussions and complex textures he can create "soundscapes" with a wide palette…

Born on December 24 1989 in Brooklyn NY, child prodigy Chris Malinchak became a household name with the 2013 release of his iconic record So Good To Me. Startlingly fresh, it quickly became the most Shazamed record in the uk and the most played record on BBC Radio 1.

There are at least 5 Chronos out there: 1. Dj Shankar (Chronos Project) aka Nick Klimenko from Russia was only 20 years old when discovered by Sunline Records. His musical background and love for Nature immediately made them soul mates and an agreement to release “Steps to the Great Knowledge” was born a few days after.

DJ Zombi - Beat Boutique Records - Tel Aviv For the past 20 years DJ Zombi has been an integral part of the Israeli dance music scene, carving out a career that has cemented his name in the annals of music industry folklore.

Ozric Tentacles are an English instrumental rock band formed in Somerset in 1983. Their music incorporates elements of psychedelic rock, progressive rock, space rock, jazz fusion, electronic music, dub, world music and ambient music.

Kiasmos is made up of Icelandic BAFTA-winning composer Ólafur Arnalds, known for his unique blend of minimal piano and string compositions with electronic sounds, and Janus Rasmussen from the Faroe Islands, known as the mastermind of the electro-pop outfit Bloodgroup.

Seb Wildblood has spent the last few years forging a sonic identity focused on transportive experiences. Whether it’s in tracks designed for the dancefloor, or in those more suited to headphones, the recurring theme across his musical output is one of subtlety and depth.

Zen Baboon is composed of Daniel Rosado and Henrique Palhavã. Both were born in the 70`s in Portugal and since an early age kept a close connection with the music world. Musically and without mention any names and styles, both love projects with great sound quality and with original construction.

The Duo Okvsho is one of the most promising prospects of upcoming musicians and producers from Switzerland. The two brothers grew up in the city of Zurich with influences from oldschool beatmaking and house/electronic music to the modern Jazz-Scene, Funk and Neosoul.

Behdad Nejatbakhshe (a.k.a Uppermost, from Paris, France) was 17 when he discovered music production. He took his first steps through FL Studio and listened to artists like deadmau5, the Daft Punk duo or Rank-1, who brought him much inspiration.

songs.wiki: “Bekhauf”, released on 6 December 2024, is a single by the Indian metal band Bloodywood featuring the Japanese metal group BABYMETAL, marking the first collaboration between the two acts. The title is taken from Hindi and translates to “fearless”, reflecting the song’s theme of confronting and managing fear rather than avoiding it.

songs.bio: Born in Scotland, raised in Yorkshire and living in Berlin since 2013. Youandewan is Ewan Smith, a DJ and producer who has quietly but consistently gone about forging his own tender brand of deep house.
Fatimah Nyeema Warner (born September 18, 1991), known professionally as Noname, is an American rapper, poet, and record producer from the Bronzeville neighborhood of Chicago.
There are at least 2 artists named Speedometer: 1. Speedometer (band): Since forming as a quartet in 1998, Speedometer has been at the forefront of the funk and soul scene.

The Doors was an American rock band formed in Los Angeles in 1965, consisting of vocalist Jim Morrison, keyboardist Ray Manzarek, guitarist Robby Krieger, and drummer John Densmore. The band became known for its distinctive sound, Morrison’s lyrical style and vocal delivery, and the group’s association with the 1960s counterculture.
songs.wiki: "Roadhouse Blues" is a blues-rock song written and recorded by the American rock band The Doors. The song, which appeared on the B-side of You Make Me Real, was first released as a single from the album Morrison Hotel in March 1970 and peaked at #50.

The story behind NTO started with a match made in heaven, a kid from the South of France always hooked to his guitar, and electronic music. After going to the Sziget Festival when he was 18, NTO started to hang out regularly at La Villa Rouge, and Bar Live, two legendary clubs in the South of France.

Derek Vincent Smith (born November 25, 1981) is an American electronic music artist who performs under the stage name Pretty Lights. He is also the proprietor of an associated music label, Pretty Lights Music.
Hermeth is an electro, ghetto tech and breaks DJ producer since 2019, signing to the Brainwaves label, based in Geneva, Switzerland.

Kimmo Huusko, better known as Huge L (not to be confused with HUGEL, French DJ - https://www.last.fm/music/HUGEL+), is a rapper and producer from Vantaa, Finland. Known for his prolific output, he has released dozens of albums since 2002.

He has an extensive catalog of original productions and remixes to his credit, ranging from tribal to progressive house, as well as incorporating garage and latin elements.

Opal Sunn is a live-performance duo by Al Kassian & Hiroaki OBA. The aim is to transcend the improvisational magic of the studio jam and funnel it into the live performance. Al Kassian and Hiroaki OBA are Opal Sunn.

Sofiane Pamart is a French pianist, based in Paris and originally from Hellemmes in the suburbs of Lille. He is known to the French public for breaking the elitist codes of classical piano. As a gold medallist at the Conservatoire de Lille, he took a different track from the typical classical music path.

A.M.R, real name Amr Hachicho, is a progressive and melodic house producer from Doha, Qatar. He was born on June 1989 in Canada and has lived in the small country of Qatar his entire life.
